book.name: 2 TESALONAIKA
book.title: 2 TESALONAIKA Pol so mamey meyki ma mey hok non, kristen Tesalonaika ko me

content: Hano wayh-om, hromo Hakamay Jisas Krais so ma-le enekwei o, hrom suhway-aw hye nion non-wak e ma swa-hokruw o, seme ma lohruw-a hokwe, hakwe hme senkin lonseyn,

homkwe ok, uwrsa hom senkin ma me, Hakamay so ma-le enekwei hokwe papo lousne, seme peie lonuayk owk la-pa-la o, seyr hme mon preiryay e ipan peie lon kow o. Mo uwrsa har hom senkin me hi, ok somokwe hromkiaw me, profet-ok o, hiymon sorasor ok o, mamey hromo uru non ma mey o, yerki sohom mo kamon non.

Ama, homkwe uwrsa, hme okrei-ok senkin ma mesor me, hme peie isay mesor warei-arei kow o. Payhokuaw, Hakamay so ma-le enekwei hokwe peyr liy saw-e ley, me-puar-yor aiopey o, God so sow me kamaun-sow-uwr ipey-ar o, hoh non-ousne sehe. God so sow me kamaun-sow-uwr sohokwe yier piap-araw mon ley ey hiy non.

Hiykwe omeme senkin senkin, god-ok ma mowie, uwrsa, hom ma kampueys me-ihey me kokwe aw-mar lohre ey. Sawk hiykwe yop, God so a pekney-weys mon liwak ey kokwe hiykiaw-ayay kow iwak ey. Seyr hiykiaw-ayay senkin mesor nakian nakian ey, hiykwe God-ar.
Hmey, homkwe ok somokwe ma-nanpanan pey? Ha hme nion ma non-wak hokwe, hakwe hme po mesor kow wayr-wayr.
Enekwei enkin, God so sow me kamaun-sow-uwr se yor penkin hok kiy-mon sosor e, homkwe nonkway. Hye kokwe sehe kiy-mon sosor, hye kokwe enekwei-ar, God hiykiaw ma meir kow sok mon ousne hrahra ha ey.

God so sow me kamaun-sow-yor ouon-aw ma lwak sue hokwe pa kiy-meio. Sawk uwr, God so sow me kamaun-sow-yor ouon-aw ma lwak sue sokwe ma nekie prosue hiykwe senkinaw-aw mon sosor wayr ey, omok hye huonok ohya sehe.

Sei, God so sow me kamaun-sow-uwr sohokwe enekwei sohiy non lousne ey. Sawk Hakamay Jisas hiykwe hye kokwe hyo howniy woki ko non losiahakar akre akre ey, seyr hyo krai panpaniowni non hiykiaw ma nak-aye non nuw-mon piapay okrue ha ey.
God so sow me kamaun-sow-uwr hiykwe Satan so krai non nak-ousne ey, seyr hiykwe meir suwon o, mey krai ipey-ar non o, okrei weynpaweyn non nak-meio ousne ey.

Seyr hiykwe uwrsa, lira por ha yerki mon ma lanio seme, hyo okrei-weynpaweyn senkin senkin non mon weih-a-weih huonok ey. Uwrsa somokwe seme lira por ha ey, payhokuaw, homkwe God so okar-ok ke kar nonaw huonok yawriy pa, seyr hyo ok, hme huonok prosue ey me uron-pi ko-ar lwak pa.
Uwrsa, God so ok ke hyaw ma lwak somokwe, God hiykwe hmo uron me nuwnak-mon hyan-a-hyan sawor-awor ha, hom senkin nan kiykiy-ay e, hmo okrei-ok somokwe okar-ar.
Sa omok kokwe senkin lwak ey, uwrsa lowpwarowp God so ok-ar-ok ke ma nan kiykiy-ay lopa, sawk yor piap-araw me wa ma nakey mokwe, God hiykwe senkin me ey, homkwe heyn aiopey hay non.

Hano wayh, Hakamay hiy uron-pi ko-ar ma lwak om, hromkwe God se kokwe enekwei enekwei hme hokuaw seme me-ihey e, payhokuaw, God hiykwe hme peyrmawk-ar sehe lahan iaup, hme hyo Niohney so krai non huonokyaw prosue e, seyr hme hyo uwrsa pekney-weys mon wak e, hom hyo okar-ok ke ma nan kiykiy-ay so kueir non.
God so ok-ihey, hrom hme ma mesor kow mo kueir mokwe, God hiykwe hme seme me-huonok prosue, hom hromo Hakamay Jisas Krais so panpaniowni se non-wawwaw onok e.
Wayh-om, homkwe kwa lorok kraiay, okar-ok hrom hme woki non ma mesor kow o, mamey non ma mey kow o, seme kwa nakruok kraiay popriy.

Hromo Aio God, hreme hyo maym ko kueir nonaw lwak peyow hiy-me woro-woro ok o, uron hyohyo lon yor ma wei-a-wei lopa o, seme ma kow hiykwe hreme uron-pi ko-ar nuw-wak. Sa hromo Hakamay Jisas Krais hiykiaw o, hromo Aio God o, hohkwe hme ka hiy-me woro-woro, seyr hme ka hiymon kraipakrai, sa hmo mey o, hmo ok o, yaprue ka lwak e hokuaw.
